about: Background music bank for In This Town. Reuse a track whenever its mood fits; only generate a new one in ElevenLabs when nothing fits. Tracks are ~47 s instrumentals made to loop; addbed.py loops and ducks them under the narrator.
rules: Pick by mood first, then energy. Reusing the same track on several videos is fine and expected.

New track only when no mood fits: ElevenLabs Music v2.5, instrumental, 47 s, steady energy, no intro/ending (loopable), sparse, no lead melody in the vocal range. One take (generations_count 1). About 700 credits.
Add every new track here (mood tags, prompt, generation id, credits) before using it.
Mix: python3 -I addbed.py FILM VOICE TRACK_ID OUT (bed ~13 dB under speech, ducked, -14 LUFS).
Sponsor (Flashloop) Instagram editions: ElevenLabs music terms may not cover paid/sponsored content on our plan; keep sponsor editions music-free until checked.
